title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: X ships an official hosted MCP server — 200+ endpoints, agents can search/read/analyze X in real time (read-only for now)
bullets.summary: Launched June 30, X's hosted MCP server exposes 200+ API endpoints (post search, timelines, profile lookup, bookmarks, likes/retweets, plus a docs hub) to any MCP client via browser OAuth; it is NOT wired to the Write API, so agents can read and analyze but cannot post autonomously.
bullets.how: Drop-in social-listening + trend-analysis backend for Pulse / Brand 9 Signs without maintaining API plumbing; posting still routes through our existing multi-channel browser flow.

bullets.title: Anthropic — Claude Sonnet 5 becomes Claude Code's default with native 1M-token context + 'dynamic workflows' research preview
bullets.summary: Claude Code now defaults to Sonnet 5 with a 1M-token window (promo pricing to Aug 31) and adds dynamic workflows that let Claude plan large tasks, spin up many parallel subagents, and verify results before reporting back, plus org default models and background-session reliability fixes.
bullets.how: Directly upgrades The Construct's own agent substrate: bigger context for whole-repo/whole-corpus jobs and native parallel-subagent orchestration for the daily scans and Hermes-driven background work.

bullets.title: Salesforce ships Agentic B2C Developer Toolkit (June '26) — CLI + MCP server + agent skills, CRM Contact ID embedded in the storefront auth token
bullets.summary: Agentforce Commerce's largest release yet gives shopper agents secure, instant access to full customer context by baking the CRM Contact ID into the storefront authentication token, exposed through a unified CLI, MCP server, and IDE extension.
bullets.how: Reference pattern for PRAGMA's AI-operator work: how to hand an agent authenticated, per-customer CRM context safely; relevant if/when a Construct client runs on Salesforce commerce.

bullets.title: DeepSeek V4 preview — 1.6T-param mixture-of-experts frontier reasoner tuned for long-context coding and analysis
bullets.summary: DeepSeek's V4 preview lands as a 1.6-trillion-parameter MoE built for long-context reasoning with strong coding/analysis, extending the low-cost open-weight pressure on the frontier labs.
bullets.how: Candidate cheap high-context backend to benchmark against Sonnet 5 for The Construct's long-corpus reasoning jobs; validate quality and data-governance before routing any client work to it.

bullets.title: arXiv: 'Environment-Grounded Automated Prompt Optimization for LLM Game Agents'
bullets.summary: Decomposes an agent's observation-to-action pipeline into a goal-conditioned descriptor agent and an action-selection agent, then auto-refines each module's prompt through an LLM-driven evolutionary loop scored by environment returns.
bullets.how: Concrete method for tuning Construct agents that operate in a loop (the scans, browser-automation flows): split perception from decision and let outcome signal drive prompt refinement instead of hand-editing.

praxis_lesson: The distribution platforms are now racing to become agent-callable — X (June 30) and Salesforce (June '26) join TikTok, GitHub, Slack, Stripe and the ad platforms in shipping official MCP servers, but most, like X, expose READ before WRITE. The Construct's edge for Brand 9 Signs is to treat these read-MCPs as a unified sensing layer (listen, analyze, decide) while keeping our own governed write path for anything that publishes or spends — own the decision + action layer, let the platforms commoditize the reads.
